scope: Local implementation of slice S2a of docs/QR_3_FAIR_COMPARISON_CONTRACT.md for PM-1 row F10-02: the shared exposure register as an offline PostgreSQL extension (insert-only table quant_exposure_register with a QR3_COMPARISON or QR4_SELECTION kind, marker table, guard triggers, rollback that runs only on an empty register, and an install, inspect and rollback tool), plus src/postgres/exposure-register.js with the one writer, the one reader and the adapters to the entry shapes of the committed QR-3, QR-4 and package B0 pure modules. The runtime grant script protects the register (no DELETE) and makes its marker read-only. Nothing is installed on staging, and no route, worker or view writes or reads the register yet.
method: An architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) wrote the S2 design and root accepted options D1 to D13 (recorded as RC-C28 to RC-C36). A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote S2a. An independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) and a second-opinion reviewer (Fable 5.1, transcript model verified) reviewed round 1; an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran the PostgreSQL suite, the tool and the grant script on a throwaway cluster after each round. Round 2 fixed the findings (grant test lists, an upper bound on window times, one clock read per call, throws on a missing or invalid register, owner checks by role membership, marker and trigger checks) and was rechecked by the Opus auditor, then the tester ran six single-edit mutations. Reviews and mutation runs were serialized. Root ruled on every finding and made two comment-only edits after the tester run (a stale schema-list comment and the ruling date). Nobody verified their own work.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it.
result: Throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (scram-sha-256, 100 connections, one test file per process, PostgreSQL tools on PATH): test/postgres/quant-exposure-register.test.mjs 17 of 17 pass with 0 skipped; test/postgres/runtime-grants.test.mjs 1 of 1. Without a database: the adapter and grant text tests pass, and root reran them with the package renderer and gate tests (88 of 88). The tool was run on a throwaway database: inspect, install, a repeated install, rollback and reinstall all exit 0; after the grant script, inspect with the runtime role reports no failures and the role holds only INSERT, SELECT and UPDATE on the register.

mutations.round2: 6 of 6 killed (no upper bound in the table check, no upper bound in the row reader, an unavailable register returning ok:false, one clock read per event, and exact-name owner checks for the table and for the functions).

limits: Register only: library G5 v2 (S2b), the QR-3 comparison tables (S2c), the evaluation job class (S3) and the API (S4) do not exist yet, so nothing writes exposure rows.
Not installed on staging. Staging needs one later data-model window with a fresh owner GO naming every step (RC-C36).
Known gaps for the shared hardening backlog: membership in a superuser or bypass-RLS role is not checked; the QR-1b freeze inspection still matches the table owner by exact name.
The backup and restore test skips when the PostgreSQL tools are not on PATH.
Constraint text is verified on PostgreSQL 16 only; another major version may classify as OTHER and fail closed.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the design, the agent reports, the rulings and the final diff and accepted S2a as local engineering evidence for F10-02. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself, installs nothing and writes no exposure row.
